title: User login

scenarios.name: Registered user logs in
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user submits the correct email and password
then: the user is redirected to the dashboard

scenarios.name: Wrong password
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user submits a wrong password
then: an 'Invalid email or password' error is shown
the user stays on the login page

scenarios.name: Empty email
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user submits the form with an empty email
then: a 'Email is required' validation message is shown

scenarios.name: Locked on fifth consecutive failure
given: a registered user with 4 consecutive failed logins
when: the user submits a wrong password a fifth time
then: the account is locked for 15 minutes

open_questions: Should lockout notify the user by email?
